description: Routing and safety cases for maintain-code-map.

cases.title: Stale lock refreshes the map before product edits
cases.prompt: The code map lock is stale. Refresh docs/codemap, then we will change the API module.

cases.title: First map writes only under docs/codemap
cases.prompt: Create the repository code map. Do not refactor anything else.

cases.title: Unproven relationships stay unknown
cases.prompt: Map this repo. Two folders sit next to each other but nothing imports across them.

cases.title: Staging validation precedes publish of json, md, html, and lock
cases.prompt: Publish a fresh code map from staging.

cases.title: Drive-wide inventory requires an explicit root
cases.prompt: Inventory every git repo under my workspace parent and publish maps.
